notes.title: PAX East Pocket Quest streams
notes.notes: Pocket Quest is being showcased at PAX East where the latest version of the game can be played.

notes.title: ⚔️ Developer Stream: Gameplay and Q&A
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108385/0a9348891261cef344a9a3397dfe928df2301f06.gif[/img]

Join Game Developers El Drijver and Tijmen Roberti as they play Pocket Quest. All gameplay will be explained while joining the PvP fray in an attempt to defeat other players.

All basic information of the game will be covered, but questions of all skill levels are welcome.
